Bug_Title: Tests method should not be annotated with competing annotations
Bug_Explanation: The bug is demonstrated by annotating a unit test method with more than one test-related annotation. In the code, test1() is annotated with both @Test and @RepeatedTest, and test2() is annotated with both @ParameterizedTest and @Test. This results in unexpected behavior like failing tests or throwing exceptions.
